test_name: Access Control - AC-17 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Payments-Core-011
Primary NIST family: Access Control (AC); evidence focus: AC-17.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: remote-access approval records are incomplete for a small contractor cohort even though the access path is private and MFA-protected. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
